company.name: Cuckoo
company.description:
Cuckoo is an always-available, in-house realtime translator. Cuckoo instantly learns the technical details of your conversation from your keywords and documents and interprets into over 20 languages—customized for your specific industry and organization. 

Global teams like Snowflake, PagerDuty, Weights & Biases, dbt Labs, and SeAH rely on Cuckoo for multilingual meetings, events, business trips, and more.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round

insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,485,046 to $13,524,934, a 2.09x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
